name: ColorWheel
summary: Adjusts hue on a circular color track.

useWhen: Choosing a hue around a wheel
avoidWhen: Editing a color channel as text

obligations: Expose the color wheel name and keyboard adjustment.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled Core color strings are supported.
Does not participate in forms and admits no name; use a named ColorField to submit a color.
onChange emits a CSS hsla(h, s%, l%, a) string, including when the value was given as hex or RGB.
accessibility: Expose the color wheel name and keyboard adjustment.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
